speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I see you're experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To begin our evaluation, can you tell me exactly how long these new symptoms have been lasting, and has your urine changed in color or smell?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your symptoms persisted despite antibiotic treatment for sinusitis, could you describe the specific color of your urine and confirm if you are experiencing urinary urgency or frequency? Additionally, have you noticed any chills or shaking rigors?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.
